test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 25 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which Article of the Indian Constitution envisages the Election Commission of India (ECI), a constitutional body established by the Constitution of India, to conduct and regulate elections in the country?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 324**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 324** of the Indian Constitution envisages the Election Commission of India (ECI).
 
• The Election Commission of India is a constitutional body established to conduct and regulate elections in the country.
 
• It ensures free and fair elections to the Parliament, State Legislatures, and the offices of the President and Vice-President in India.
 
• The ECI operates under the authority of the Constitution per Article 324, ensuring the electoral process is transparent and impartial.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Election Commission of India was established on 25th January 1950.
 
• Article 324(1) states that the superintendence, direction, and control of the preparation of the electoral rolls and the conduct of elections shall be vested in the Election Commission.
 
• The ECI is an autonomous constitutional authority responsible for administering election processes in India at both the national and state levels.
 
• The Commission consists of the Chief Election Commissioner and such number of other Election Commissioners as the President may from time to time fix.
 
• The Chief Election Commissioner and the Election Commissioners are appointed by the President of India.
 
• The ECI ensures the model code of conduct is followed by political parties and candidates during elections.
 
• The Constitution of India mandates that elections to the House of the People and to the Legislative Assemblies of States be held on the basis of adult suffrage.
